test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Kiran says that he worked hard for a good rank.

options.text: Kiran said, “I worked hard for a good rank”.
Kiran says, “I work hard for good rank”.
Kiran has said, “I worked hard for a good rank”.
Kiran says, “I worked hard for a good rank”.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in reported speech where *Kiran is speaking in the** present*** - he** "says".**
 
• In direct speech, this would reflect an ongoing action or a fact true to Kiran and not dependent on another event. 
 
• Therefore,** he would say**, *"I worked hard for a good rank".*
 
• **Options 1 and 3 **refer to past instances, while **option 2 **indicates a current ongoing action, which doesn't match with the original sentence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Kiran says, “I worked hard for a good rank”.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting indirect speech to direct speech, the adherence to the exact tense and context of the original event is crucial.
